title: Orange County executive race: Early results role in as Neuhaus and Sussman watch close contest - NewsBreak
text:
By Blaise Gomez ,
1 days ago
Orange County voters are deciding tonight whether to reelect longtime County Executive Steve Neuhaus or bring in new leadership under Democrat Michael Sussman in what’s become one of the region’s most closely watched local races.
Neuhaus, a Republican seeking a fourth term, is spending election night with supporters at the Castle Fun Center in Chester, where the mood is upbeat as early returns begin to come in.
Neuhaus told News 12 earlier today that he feels confident, pointing to his record on taxes, public safety and emergency management, saying he’s “led the county through crisis and growth.”
Sussman, a civil rights attorney and former Town of Chester councilman, is watching results with supporters at his home. He’s campaigned on transparency, ethics reform and restoring trust in county government, while also calling for a county comptroller position and new policies to support small businesses and affordable housing.
The race has drawn intense attention across Orange County with everything from taxes and overdevelopment to controversy in county government and the future of Stewart International Airport emerging as major issues for voters.
Stay with News 12 throughout the night for live updates and results on-air, online and across our social platforms.
